description: Return the deviation that a general-tolerance note such as ISO 2768-m implies for one dimension, so an unmarked dimension can be checked. The tables differ by what they cover: linear dimensions, broken edges (external radii and chamfer heights), and angular dimensions, which are keyed by the shorter side of the angle rather than the nominal size. A general tolerance applies only where the drawing gives no individual tolerance, so check for one first.

kind.description: Which table to read: linear dimensions (default), broken edges such as chamfers and external radii, or angular dimensions. They have different values.

nominal.description: Nominal size, or the shorter side of an angle.

tolerance_class.description: Class letter from the drawing note, e.g. m.

name: general_tolerance
title: ISO 2768-1 General Tolerance
